hints.title: Bit Concentration Invariant
hints.text: Replacing (x, y) with (x & y, x | y) transfers 1-bits between numbers without altering the total count of set bits at any bit position.

hints.title: Convexity of Squares
hints.text: Because (A + B)^2 > A^2 + B^2 for positive integers, concentrating 1-bits into fewer, larger numbers strictly maximizes the sum of squares.

hints.title: Greedy Construction
hints.text: Count occurrences of each bit across all numbers. Construct the top k largest numbers greedily by collecting all available bits, and sum their squares modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: k: number of elements to select
complexity.notes: Bit count array of constant size 31.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating pairwise operations leads to infinite permutations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space for 31 bit counters.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that OR/AND operation preserves bit frequencies and squares benefit from bit concentration.
